title: Default jurisdiction is tax-free, silently undercharging
instruction: test_entries.py::test_default_jurisdiction_is_taxed is failing. When no jurisdiction is given, baskets are charged no tax at all. The default jurisdiction should be US-CA. Fix the ledger package. Do not change the tests. Run tests/test_entries.py.

ground_truth.why_multi_file: Deliberately shallow: a one-line constant with a short path to the fix. Included so the benchmark contains a case where compression has little to work with.
